source.title: Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Nominations in Tyrone")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: nominations read on the block images of the Ulster Herald's 'Strabane Council and Guardians: one contest threatened' (26 April 1930, p. 5, article ULH19300426.2.75): the only threatened contest was Lislea; one nomination in every other division

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Lislea (Plumbridge) was the only contest in the district; the other divisions were returned unopposed and are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The unopposed returns in the other divisions (and Tullyard, where the retiring member was deemed elected) are added from the Ulster Herald's nominations list of 26 April 1930, p. 5 (6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
